about: What makes one creature other than the rest of its kind, along one axis each: how old it is, how big, what part it has among its kind, the country it was bred in, how it is disposed, what has got into it. A creature is its species with any of these laid over it, one at most of each axis (Variant elder. Variant great. in a Person), never a species of its own for each (the owner, 4 November night). Each says the word it is called by before its kind (an old great rat), what is seen of it, and what it adds: to its qualities, its health at each level, its abilities and its natural traits (data/catalog/traits.json). kinds: the kinds of creature it can be (animal, monster, spirit). hint: a Deem condition on where it is met, by which a generated country lays it on what dens there (climate: arid, cold, humid, temperate, tropical; habitat: the kind of country, as RegionEcology names it); one without a hint is only ever an author's.

young.says: not yet grown: quick, unsure of itself, and readier to run

elder.says: grey and scarred, the one the others make way for, and the last to run

runt.says: small for its kind, and the quicker for it

great.says: twice the size of the rest of its kind

brood_mother.says: swollen and slow, keeping to her eggs and not leaving them

drove.says: a small working dog, quick on its feet and accustomed to the road

source.notes: The SRD dog as a breed of the working dog: 1d8+2 Hit Dice, six fixed scores, a bite at +2 for 1d4+1, saves +4/+5/+1 and AC 15 converted to Westernesse 6. The drover's grey dog is peaceable; this changes her body, not the investigation or a hostile encounter. Omitted: low-light vision, scent, skills, movement and size rules. Kyr's criticals and piercing-wound triggers differ. Named only, never drawn into dens.

pack_leader.says: the one the rest follow, and watch

frost.says: thick-coated and pale, bred where the winters are long

marsh.says: dark and slick with the mud of the fens it was bred in

sunburnt.says: lean and dun-coloured, bred where the sun is hard

cave.says: of the deep dark: pale, long in the leg, at home where nothing sees

starving.says: ribs showing; it will not wait to be sure of you

blighted.says: something has got into it: patchy, weeping, and wrong in the way it moves

skeletal.says: bare bone held together by what raised it, nothing in its eye-pits but a faint light

source.notes: Orsino's undead template, as a variation of its own axis, with the SRD skeleton template's defenses (srd-proving-cases.md case 53): damage reduction 5/bludgeoning and immunity to cold (exact), in place of Orsino's Bone Resilience (half of a point's blow, twice a club's), whose proof against bleeding it keeps (bloodless). Its Hit Dice, armour and blows stay Orsino's template's.

skeletal_held.says: bare bone held together by what raised it, nothing in its eye-pits but a faint light

source.notes: Held (srd-proving-cases.md case 53): the skeletal template without the SRD skeleton's damage reduction 5/bludgeoning and immunity to cold, for the skeletal beasts denned in a work's room at the first level (RegionStock.den: iscoed's bone-hound pairs on the golden route), until a blunt weapon is on offer in the first town. Never drawn as a template.

spectral.says: a cold grey shape of what it was, which blows go through

source.notes: Orsino's undead template, as a variation of its own axis; what the dead are proof against or hurt by is their traits' (undead, skeletal, incorporeal).

vampiric.says: pale and red-mouthed, quicker than it was alive, and hungry for blood

source.notes: Orsino's undead template, as a variation of its own axis; what the dead are proof against or hurt by is their traits' (undead, skeletal, incorporeal).

zombie.says: dead flesh walking, slow and stinking, falling apart as it comes

source.notes: Orsino's undead template, as a variation of its own axis; what the dead are proof against or hurt by is their traits' (undead, skeletal, incorporeal).

custodian.says: set to keep a place, with a sweep of the arm and a chain for whoever will not go

source.notes: The bronze custodian's sweep and chain and its proof against blows, as a role any construct can be set to (the low-water undercroft's, the cistern's).

clay.says: made of clay: red-brown, smooth when wet and cracking when dry

iron.says: made of iron: grey-black, rust at the seams

wood.says: made of wood: grained, brown to grey

gold.says: made of gold: deep yellow that does not dull

bone.says: made of bone: yellow-white, porous at the ends

crystal.says: made of crystal: clear, with the light caught in it

silver.says: made of silver: white and bright, blackening in the air

glass.says: made of glass: clear or green, sharp where it breaks

platinum.says: made of platinum: grey-white and very heavy

barrow.says: of the old breed of the barrows: quick, grey and long-nailed, its bite and claws stiffening what they touch

source.notes: The SRD ghoul as a variation of Orsino's (ghoul/barrow): its 2d12 Hit Dice (13 at any level), its scores (13, 15, 10 for its Con it has none of, 13, 14, 12), a bite at +2 for 1d6+1 and two claws at +0 for 1d3, its saves of +0, +2 and +5 (exact), and AC 14 as Westernesse 7 (converted: the SRD's natural armour 2 and Dexterity 2 are the Dexterity modifier of 15 plus one natural armour). Its paralysis rides on each bite and claw that lands, a Fortitude save against 12 or paralysed three turns (the SRD's 1d4+2 rounds), in place of Orsino's Paralyzing Touch. Omitted: ghoul fever, turn resistance, elves' immunity; Orsino's Curse, Scream, Life Drain and regeneration it goes without. Never drawn into a den: placed by hand once, alone, as the keeper of the vault under the first town (undertown.kyrt), never in the ossuary's brood, where the SRD ghoul killed what Orsino's had been fought by (srd-invariants.md, Withdrawn; placements.md).

royal.says: one of the kings of the barrows, laid in his grave-goods and embalmed to keep: tall and heavy-handed, slow, and so terrible to see that the living stand still before him

source.notes: The SRD mummy as a breed of Orsino's (mummy/royal, srd-proving-cases.md case 30): its 8d12+3 Hit Dice (55 at any level), its scores (24, 10, 10 for the Constitution it has none of, 6, 14, 15), one slam of 1d6 a turn (the SRD's one; Orsino's mummy acts twice) for 1d6+10 (the breed's 1d6+3 and its Strength's 7: exact), struck at the SRD's +11 (exact), its saves of +4, +2 and +8 (exact), AC 20 as Westernesse 1 (converted: its natural armour 10 as a hide bonus of 9 over its wrappings), damage reduction 5/- (exact), and fire half again (Orsino's mummy's, the SRD's vulnerability: exact). Its despair is the Despair ability (a fear save against 16, two rounds paralysed: adapted, its act once a day, not at sight). Omitted: mummy rot (a disease by days). It goes without Orsino's half of every blow (forgoes.resistances), its regeneration, and its Curse, Scream, Life Drain, Mass Curse and Reckless Attack. Kept from its base: the undead's nature (radiant harms it double). Never drawn into a den: placed by hand as the king under the mound, the keeper of the king-barrow (data/generation/deep/barrow.json), never as the halls' dwellers, where the SRD's body would be lethal to the companies that meet them.

fell.says: of the fell breed: as heavy as a bear and as quick as an owl, with a hug that breaks bones

source.notes: The SRD owlbear as a breed of Orsino's (owlbear/fell): its 5d10+25 Hit Dice (52 at any rank), its scores (21, 12, 21, 2, 12, 10, from Orsino's 17, 8, 11, 3, 3, 3), two claws at +9 for 1d6+5 and a bite at +4 for 1d8+2, its saves of +9, +5 and +2 (exact), and AC 15 as Westernesse 6 (converted: its natural armour 5, Dexterity 1 and Large size -1 are Westernesse's natural 2 and Dexterity 1; it wears no hide). Omitted: improved grab, scent. Orsino's Maul, Charge, Enrage, Poison Bite and Stomp it goes without, and its wild aspect (+2 to hit, +1 to every roll, evasion, bonus damage and a tenth off all harm). A brute of challenge 4: placed only where it is warned of and can be gone round or baited (srd-proving-cases.md case 62).

long.says: as long as a man, of the old drains and the warm dark: its bite numbs, and goes on numbing after

source.notes: The SRD Medium monstrous centipede as a breed of Orsino's centipede (centipede/long, srd-proving-cases.md case 63): its 1d8 Hit Dice (4 at any rank), its scores (9, 15, 10, 10, 2 from Orsino's 5, 7, 5, 5, 4; mindless, its Intelligence is left as Orsino's), its bite at +2 for 1d6-1 (minimum one), its saves of +2, +2 and +0 (exact), and AC 14 as Westernesse 7 (converted: its natural armour 2 and Dexterity 2 are the Dexterity modifier of 15 plus one natural armour, as the barrow ghoul). Its poison rides on each bite that lands: a save against 10 or 1d3 off Dexterity (Numbed, on the world's clock for a day), and a watch later a second save against 10 or 1d3 more (the venom working: centipede_venom), the two adding up (exact, but its time). Adapted: the second save a watch after, where the SRD's is a minute; the Dexterity back at the end of the day, where the SRD's comes back a point a day. Omitted: darkvision, vermin traits. Orsino's Venomous Bite it goes without. Never drawn into a den: placed by hand, alone, as the old drain's centipede under the first town (undertown.kyrt), which is warned of and gone round by keeping to the cold side.

midden.says: of the middens and the drains, the size of a dog: its bite carries the filth fever

source.notes: The SRD dire rat as a breed of the catalog's rat (rat/midden, srd-proving-cases.md case 64): its 1d8+1 Hit Dice (5 at any rank), its scores (10, 17, 12, 1, 12, 4 from the rat's 4, 10, 6, 3, 10, 3), its bite of 1d4 (exact), struck at the SRD's +4 (exact), its saves of +3, +5 and +3 (exact), and AC 15 as Westernesse 6 (converted: its natural armour 1, Dexterity 3 and Small size 1 are the Dexterity modifier of 17 plus one natural armour). Its filth fever rides on each bite that lands: a disease save against 11, or the fever caught (filth_fever), coming on after 1d3 days on the world's clock as Fevered, 1d3 off Dexterity and Constitution for a day. Adapted: one throw for both scores, where the SRD's throws each; the toll taken once, where the SRD's is taken each day until two saves in a row are made. Omitted: low-light vision, scent, Climb and Swim. Never drawn into a den: placed by hand, alone, as the old buck rat that keeps the corn-store's nest under the first town (undertown.kyrt), told of by the rats' run and gone round by a firebomb thrown from the runs.

wild.says: of the old woods, heavy in the shoulder and quick to anger, and once it has charged it does not stop

source.notes: The SRD boar as a breed of Orsino's boar (boar/wild, srd-proving-cases.md case 65): its 3d8+12 Hit Dice (25 at any rank), its scores (15, 10, 17, 2, 13, 4) in place of Orsino's rolled ones (scores: the first record to say them), its gore of 1d8 with its Strength (the tusks', 1d8+3: exact), struck at the SRD's +4 (exact), its saves of +6, +3 and +2 (exact), and AC 16 as Westernesse 5 (converted: its natural armour 6 as the boar's hide and a bonus of 4). Omitted: ferocity (the SRD's boar fights on while disabled or dying, which Westernesse's fallen do not), low-light vision, scent. A brute of challenge 2: never drawn into a den; placed by hand as the wood's old boar of the open country's meetings (meetings.kyrt), met only away from the roads and the towns, its rooting seen before it warns, and gone round by the way across country out of its tract.

cellar.says: of the cellars and the sewers: small, quick and grey, and there is never only one

source.notes: The SRD rat as a breed of Westernesse's (rat/cellar), the first proof slice's creature (proof-slices.md, step 2): its 1/4 d8 Hit Dice (one hit point, at any rank it is met at), its scores (2, 15, 10, 2, 12, 2, from the rat's), its bite at +4 for 1d3-4 (minimum one), AC 14 as Westernesse 7 (its fur and its quickness: converted), and its saves of +2, +4 and +1 (exact). Adapted: a Tiny creature's reach and space, low-light vision and scent are not modelled; its bite lays whatever a piercing wound lays in Westernesse, which the SRD's does not (engine-pressure.md, section 7). Unplaced: named only, never drawn into a den, until its envelope is measured and one ecology row reviewed.

flesh.says: stitched together from the dead and bolted at the joints: steel does little to it

source.notes: The SRD flesh golem as the golem of flesh (golem/flesh), one archetype as the bestiary keeps it: its 9d10+30 Hit Dice (79), its scores (21, 9, 10 and 1 for the Con and Int it has none of, 11, 1), two slams of 2d8 and its Strength, and damage reduction 5/adamantine: Westernesse has no adamantine blade, so every blow of steel loses five. Its AC 18 is the golem's plate (Westernesse 4, a point short). Omitted: immunity to magic and the spells that slow or heal it (spell interaction, increment C), berserk; Orsino's Smash and Defend it goes without. Placed nowhere until its placement is fought (placements.md).

bronze.says: made of bronze: brown-gold, dark with handling

source.notes: Between stone and iron; Orsino has no bronze golem.
